newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela May inflation rises to 3.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela May inflation rises to 3.1 pct.

text.p: Venezuelan consumer prices rose 3.1 percent in May, down from a 12.6 percent peak in May 1996 but up from 2.4 percent in April this year, the Central Bank said.
May's rate, which fell within market expectations, took inflation over the first five months of the year to 12.5 percent, compared to 51.5 percent last year.

Venezuela's official inflation target for 1997 remains 30 percent. Central Bank president Antonio Casas Gonzalez recently said the target was reachable if inflation over the first six months of the year was at or below below 15 percent.
